mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over the past 3 months, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS growth exceeds GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points simultaneously over the past month, it signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS and UNRATE meet the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase of more than 25 basis points in the past month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 25bps.

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary regime, a decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past 3 months signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during a recession when HOUST decreases by more than 10%.
